evidence.notes: Crystal is not described as automatic; the page does not give the threshold, a validity period for status reached this way, or a programme end date.
evidence.summary: Official programme page (launched July 14, 2026). After linking accounts, Marriott members receive FLY ON Points each year by tier: Titanium 30,000 and Ambassador 40,000, and those two tiers earn Crystal or higher according to accumulated FLY ON Points. Points arrive within about 6 weeks of linking and then each spring. One JAL account links to one Marriott account and the link cannot be changed. Benefits depend on Marriott status on the registration day and, in later years, on the status then held.
evidence.title: JAL Mileage Bank & Marriott Bonvoy, Status Match Starts

evidence.summary: Reports the tier table: Titanium 30,000 FLY ON Points per year with Crystal or above, Ambassador 40,000 with Crystal or above; one account may be linked to one account and a person may register once.
evidence.title: Marriott Bonvoy and Japan Airlines Launch Preferred Partnership Program

evidence.summary: Reports that the 30,000 or 40,000 FLY ON Points given to Titanium or Ambassador members are enough for Crystal, which equates to oneworld Ruby. Also states the long-standing Marriott to JAL transfer ratio of 3 points per mile, with 5,000 bonus miles per 60,000 points transferred.
evidence.title: Marriott & Japan Airlines launch deeper partnership

open_questions: Exact FLY ON Points threshold for Crystal and whether partner-credited points fully count (two secondary sources say 30,000 is enough)
Validity period of Crystal reached through the partnership
Whether a new JAL account can be created at the time of linking

proposed_entities.name: JAL Mileage Bank FLY ON Crystal

restrictions: Account link is one-to-one and cannot be changed afterwards
Points take up to about 6 weeks after linking
Crystal depends on accumulated FLY ON Points, not on the link alone

retention.note: Annual points follow the Marriott tier held each year. How long Crystal reached this way lasts, and whether it survives loss of the Marriott tier mid-year, is not stated officially.

proposed_rule.summary: Marriott Titanium or Ambassador Elite members who link their Marriott Bonvoy and JAL Mileage Bank accounts receive 30,000 or 40,000 FLY ON Points a year and reach JAL Crystal (or higher) on accumulated points.
proposed_rule.value_note: Crystal carries oneworld Ruby. Useful on JAL and oneworld flights in economy; largely redundant when already flying business class.
